description: Action registry — risk levels and handler taxonomy. This file is documentation-only at runtime (no code reads it); the canonical list of agent-emitted action types lives in api/companyHeartbeat/constants.js KNOWN_ACTION_TYPES, and the canonical list of executable types lives in api/actionsExecute/executors/index.js EXECUTABLE_TYPES. This registry describes legacy v1 type names that the Heavy-tier audit surfaced as ambiguous, now annotated with their real handler path for future maintainability.

handlerTaxonomy.actionsExecute: Has an HTTP executor in api/actionsExecute/executors/ — runs when CEO approves the action in the dashboard. Currently: social_post.publish/schedule/reply, publish_document.
handlerTaxonomy.heartbeat: Auto-executes during a heartbeat cycle in api/companyHeartbeat/agent-runner.js (Nova lifecycle branch or similar). No CEO approval needed; reversible operations.
handlerTaxonomy.heartbeat-mutation: Handled by api/companyHeartbeat/task-mutations.js — pure state changes on tasks/docs. Agent emits via the hyphen-cased names in KNOWN_ACTION_TYPES (create-task, update-task, etc.).
handlerTaxonomy.approval-queue: Agent emits → written to approvalQueue state key → CEO decides. No automated executor; CEO action drives next step.
handlerTaxonomy.heartbeat-approval-queue: Agent proposes via heartbeat, lands in approvalQueue for CEO approval (irreversible operations like cancel_campaign).
handlerTaxonomy.legacy: Registry entry predates current architecture. Real flow is documented in deprecation_note. Kept as historical documentation; no runtime impact.
handlerTaxonomy.dead: No handler anywhere in the codebase. Safe to remove once all references (prompts, tests, docs) are scrubbed.

actions.name: Add task comment
actions.deprecation_note: v1 legacy. Real flow: agents emit the hyphen-cased `comment-task` action which is handled by task-mutations.js in the heartbeat. No runtime handler for this v1 name exists.

actions.name: Label task
actions.deprecation_note: v1 legacy. Task tags are set directly via create-task / update-task actions handled in task-mutations.js. No handler for this specific type.

actions.name: Move task to lane
actions.deprecation_note: v1 legacy. Agents use `move-task` (hyphen-cased) handled by task-mutations.js. No handler for this specific type.

actions.name: Request missing info
actions.deprecation_note: v1 legacy. Agents add clarifying comments via comment-task or reassign via update-task. No dedicated handler for request_info.

actions.name: Move task to Done
actions.deprecation_note: v1 legacy. Status transitions to 'done' are handled via the peer-review auto-complete path in task-mutations.js (social_copy + hero_image auto-complete) or explicit CEO status change. Agents do not emit this name.

actions.name: Queue social draft for approval
actions.deprecation_note: v1 legacy. Real flow: agent emits `create-social-action` → approvalQueue → CEO approves → actionsExecute runs social_post.publish/schedule. See api/actionsExecute/executors/social/.

actions.name: Create task
actions.handler_note: Canonical name: `create-task` (hyphen-cased). Handled by api/companyHeartbeat/task-mutations.js. Passes through 8 blocking gates (orphan/dup/ceiling/etc.) — see Governance system. Policy-violation logged on any gate fire.

actions.name: Delete task
actions.deprecation_note: Intentionally disabled. Tasks are moved to archived status rather than deleted, preserving audit trail.

actions.name: Publish social post live
actions.deprecation_note: v1 legacy. Real flow: actionsExecute route social_post.publish (via bluesky/x/linkedin/facebook/reddit executors). See api/actionsExecute/executors/social/.

actions.name: Publish content or article
actions.deprecation_note: v1 legacy. Real flow: agent emits `submit-for-publish` → approvalQueue → CEO approves → actionsExecute publish_document. See api/actionsExecute/executors/content/publishDocument.js.

actions.name: Queue blog draft
actions.deprecation_note: v1 legacy. Blog drafts are created via `create-doc` (kind: marketing_post) handled by task-mutations.js, then submitted via submit-for-publish. See documents state key.

actions.name: Open pull request
actions.deprecation_note: v1 legacy. No git integration currently exists; CEO opens PRs manually from the dev environment.

actions.name: Apply system adjustment
actions.deprecation_note: v1 legacy. No handler. Forge can issue `system_directive` tasks (a distinct mechanism) to course-correct other agents — see DIRECTIVE_AUTHORIZED_AGENTS in constants.js.

actions.name: Propose a marketing campaign
actions.handler_note: Canonical name: `propose-campaign`. Echo/Nova emit → written to approvalQueue state via agentchat/index.js (or heartbeat agent-runner.js). CEO approval auto-creates the campaign.

actions.name: Request budget for experiment / campaign / high-cost action
actions.handler_note: Canonical name: `request-budget`. Any agent emits with { request: { type: 'experiment'|'campaign'|'high-cost-action', estimatedCost, justification, contextActionId?, contextCampaignId? } }. Handler routes by cost tier: <$0.50 auto-approved (unless squeeze mode), $0.50-$2 → pendingRequests.pending_cipher, >$2 → pendingRequests.pending_ceo + approvalQueue entry (kind: budget_request). System 12 — Capital Allocation.

actions.name: Approve or reject a pending budget request
actions.handler_note: Canonical name: `approve-budget-request`. Cipher-only (CAPITAL_AUTHORIZED_AGENTS gate). Emits with { requestId, decision: 'approved'|'rejected', note }. Updates capitalAllocation.pendingRequests + decisionLog; rejection writes auto:budget-rejected memory to the requesting agent.

actions.name: Propose hiring a new agent
actions.handler_note: Canonical name: `propose-hire-agent`. Forge-only (FLEET_MUTATION_AUTHORIZED_AGENTS); CEO via direct POST. Rate-limited 1/day. Required: hire.id (≤12 chars, not already in registry), name, role, tier (2/3/4), focus, reportsTo (existing agent or null), monthlyCap, doctrine, expectedActionMix, systemPromptTemplate, rationale, estimatedMonthlySpend. Lands in approvalQueue as agent_hire_proposal. On CEO approve: agentRegistry appended; next heartbeat includes new agent via _EXEC_GROUPS fallback. System 14 — Agent Identity Evolution.

actions.name: Propose retiring an existing agent
actions.handler_note: Canonical name: `propose-retire-agent`. Forge-only; CEO via direct POST. PROTECTED_AGENTS (nova, cipher) cannot be retired. Self-proposal blocked. FLEET_MIN_SIZE = 5. Required: retire.targetAgent (must exist, status='active'), rationale, reassignmentPlan, estimatedWinddownCost. Lands as agent_retire_proposal. On CEO approve: open tasks reassign to DOMAIN_LEAD_MAP[target] (fallback nova), agent status → archived, memories preserved. System 14.

actions.name: Propose evolving an agent's role / doctrine / cap
actions.handler_note: Canonical name: `propose-role-evolution`. Forge-only; CEO via direct POST. Self-proposal blocked. Required: evolution.targetAgent (active), changes (at least one of focus / monthlyCap / doctrine.* / expectedActionMix), rationale, estimatedCostDelta. Protected fields (cannot change): id, name, tier, status, hiredAt, retiredAt, reportsTo. Lands as agent_evolution_proposal. On CEO approve: changes merged into registry; doctrineHistory appended with pre-change snapshot. System 14 (shallow metadata only — prompt-builder branches unchanged).

actions.name: Propose a new product
actions.handler_note: Canonical name: `propose-product`. Nova-only (PRODUCT_PROPOSAL_AUTHORIZED_AGENTS). Rate-limited 1/day. Required: product.name, description, rationale, market, launchStrategy, estimatedCost (Capital Allocation carries directly), successCriteria. Lands in approvalQueue as product_proposal. CEO manually updates product-facts.json on approve. System 13 — Goal Generation.

actions.name: Propose a strategic pivot on an existing product
actions.handler_note: Canonical name: `propose-pivot`. Nova-only. Rate-limited 1/day. Required: targetProduct (must exist in product-facts.json), newDirection, rationale, successCriteria, estimatedCost (transition cost). Lands in approvalQueue as product_pivot_proposal. System 13.

actions.name: Propose retiring a product
actions.handler_note: Canonical name: `propose-retire`. Nova-only. Rate-limited 1/day. Required: targetProduct (must exist + status='active'), rationale, migrationPlan. Optional: estimatedCost (winddown cost, default 0). Lands in approvalQueue as product_retire_proposal. System 13.

actions.name: Propose a strategic objective
actions.handler_note: Canonical name: `propose-objective`. Nova-only (rate-limited 1/day). Written to approvalQueue; CEO approval auto-creates the objective. Required fields: title, description, rationale, successCriteria, timeHorizon.

actions.name: Pause an active campaign
actions.handler_note: Canonical name: `pause-campaign`. Nova auto-executes reversibly in heartbeat. 48h cooldown before resume. Handled by agent-runner.js lifecycle branch.

actions.name: Resume a paused campaign
actions.handler_note: Canonical name: `resume-campaign`. Nova auto-executes in heartbeat after 48h cooldown expires. Handled by agent-runner.js lifecycle branch.

actions.name: Mark campaign as complete
actions.handler_note: Canonical name: `complete-campaign`. Nova auto-executes in heartbeat. Handled by agent-runner.js lifecycle branch.

actions.name: Archive a stale objective
actions.handler_note: Canonical name: `archive-objective`. Nova auto-executes soft-archive after 14+ days of no activity. Handled by agent-runner.js lifecycle branch.

actions.name: Link a campaign to an objective
actions.handler_note: Canonical name: `link-campaign-to-objective`. Nova auto-executes reversibly in heartbeat — re-parents an active/paused campaign onto an ACTIVE objective, maintaining linkedCampaigns back-links both ways. Added 2026-07-28 (orphaned-goal consolidation). Handled by agent-runner.js lifecycle branch.

actions.name: Cancel a campaign (irreversible)
actions.handler_note: Canonical name: `cancel-campaign`. Nova proposes via heartbeat → lands in approvalQueue as campaign_cancellation entry. Irreversible — requires CEO approval. Handled by agent-runner.js lifecycle branch.

actions.name: Cancel an objective (irreversible)
actions.handler_note: Canonical name: `cancel-objective`. Nova proposes via heartbeat → lands in approvalQueue as objective_cancellation entry. Irreversible — requires CEO approval. Handled by agent-runner.js lifecycle branch.

actions.name: Queue AmbientScore audit of a prospect URL
actions.handler_note: Canonical name: `run-ambientscore-scan` (echo/scout/nova only). Agent emits { scan: { url, taskId, note } } via heartbeat → agent-runner validates (URL, 7d dedup, queue cap 20) and enqueues to asScanQueue → api/asScanRunner timer (every 10 min, max 2/run, systemConfig.ambientScoreScans.dailyCap default 8/day) runs the in-process analyzer and comments score + findings + shareable report link on the task. Read-only toward the prospect site; publishing anything that USES the result still flows through CEO approval. Revenue pivot 2026-07.
